name: Raven, Swarm of Ravens
printing: Monster Vault (2024), verified through the 2025 Nosolorol Spanish edition
translationLicense: Licensed Spanish edition of Kobold Press’s 2024 Monster Vault
sourceWitness: Rules translated and paraphrased from the published Spanish . The English catalog independently confirms the name, book, type, CR and habitat tags.
xpEvidence: The challenge-rating table in Cubil de Monstruos p. 17 (p. 19) gives 50 XP for CR 1/4.
errataEvidence: The 29 May 2025 Monster Vault errata lists no entry-specific change.
habitatEvidence: Official English Monster Vault catalog tags.
appearanceEvidence: Editorial description of the reused square parchment portrait.
printingNotes: The lower damage applies at 6 HP or less from the printed 13 HP. The Spanish Monster Vault gives Beaks 0-ft. reach and requires one creature in the swarm’s space. BFRD v1 lists 5-ft. reach and one target in that space.
Kobold Press’s English catalog displays this printed CR 1/4 as 0.3.
